run_perfstat_monitor: run a PerfStat monitor to collect instructions and cycles events via perf stat at a given interval
create_softreadonlylist: create a SoftReadOnlyList that returns a default value when an out-of-bounds index is accessed
unpack_perf_stat_line: unpack a comma-delimited perf stat output line into a dictionary with interval, counter-value, event, and metric fields
process_perfstat_output: process a perf stat output line to aggregate event values and calculate instructions per cycle (IPC)
review_perfstat_class: review the PerfStat class to understand how it spawns perf stat subprocesses and aggregates hardware counter data
